questions.question: The weights of 4 boxes are 20, 30, 50 and 70 kilograms. Which of the following cannot be the total weight, in kilograms, of any combination of these boxes and in a combination a box can be used only once?
questions.solution:
The combinations will be as follows:

20 + 30 + 50 + 70 = 170

70 + 30 + 50 = 150

70 + 50 = 120

But the combination of 160 is not possible.

Hence, 160 can’t be the total weight in kilograms.

questions.question: Aarav's birthday is on Sunday, 12th March. On what day of the week will be Madhup's Birthday in the same year if Madhup was born on 10th August?
questions.solution:
Aarav's birthday is on 12th March on Sunday, so 19 days of March are remaining.

Therefore count rest of the days till the last date of that month as:

Remaining days of March → 19

April → 30

May → 31

June → 30

July → 31

August → 10

Total days will be: 151

Now divide 151 by 7 (because 7 days in a week)

Remainder will be 4

Thus, 4 days after Sunday will be Thursday.

Hence, Madhup was born on Thursday, i.e. 10th August.

questions.question: If 9@7 = 4; 6@1 = 10; 7@4 = 6; then what is the value of 8@2=?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is: (x –y) × 2

9@7 → (9 – 7) × 2 = 4

6@1 → (6 – 1) × 2 = 10

7@4 → (7 – 4) × 2 = 6

Similarly,

8@2 → (8 – 2) × 2 = 12

Hence, the correct answer is 12.

questions.question: Which of the following category of the Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution includes abolition of untouchability?

options.text: Right to Liberty and Personal Freedom

questions.solution:
Option **3** is correct, __**Right to Equality**__.

__
 
• The abolition of untouchability has been included as a fundamental right in the Indian Constitution under **Article 17 **of **Right to Equality**.
 
• It is one of the few fundamental rights that are available against individuals.

**Extra facts:**

 
 

 Right to equality (Article 14-18)__
 __Consists of __
 
 

 Article 14
 Equality before the law and equal protection of laws.
 
 

 Article 15 
 Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth 
 
 

 Article 16
 Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment. 
 
 

 **Article 17**
 **Abolition of untouchability and prohibition of its practice.**

 Abolition of titles except military and academic.

questions.question: A commodity market has a _________ structure, if there is one seller of the commodity, the commodity has no substitute, and entry into the industry by another firm is prevented.
questions.solution: A monopoly market structure is one where a single firm or entity is the only supplier of a particular commodity. Characteristics of a monopoly include single seller, lack of substitutes for given commodity, profit maximization, high barriers to entry and price discrimination.

questions.question: IMF has predicted that the global economy would grow at _______% in 2017.
questions.solution: In a report released in April, 2017, IMF stated that it expected the global economy to grow at 3.5% in 2017.

questions.question: A _______ is a collection of letters, digits, punctuation characters, and so on.
questions.solution: In computer science, a string refers to any finite sequence of characters. These characters can be letters, numbers, punctuation marks, symbols, etc. A string is most commonly defined in terms of its length, i.e. the number of characters it is made up of.

questions.question: ________, succeeded to the throne of Ferghana in 1494 when he was only 12 years old.
questions.solution: Babur was the founder of the mighty Mughal dynasty in the Indian subcontinent. After the death of his father Umar Shaikh Mirza, he succeeded to the throne of Ferghana, located in present day Uzbekistan, at the age of 12. Later in 1526, he defeated Ibrahim Lodi in Battle of Panipat and thus laid the foundation of the eventual rise of Mughal rule in India.

questions.question: Animals in which the cells are arranged in two embryonic layers are called ________.
questions.solution: The term diploblastic refers to animals which have a body derived from only two embryonic cell layers, the ectoderm and the endoderm. Examples of diploblastic animals are – jellyfish, corals, sea anemone, etc. The bodies of more complex animals are triploblastic, having developed from mesoderm as well as endoderm and ectoderm germ layers.

questions.question: Name the British General who was responsible for the Jallianwalla Bagh massacre.
questions.solution: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre, also known as Amritsar massacre, happened on April 13, 1919 when troops of the British Indian Army opened fire on unarmed citizens gathered in Jallianwala Bagh on the occasion of Baisakhi. The troops acted under the command of Colonel Reginald Edward Harry Dyer.

questions.question: "Foreign jurisdiction" is listed in the __________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Union**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Constitution of India provides for a division of powers between the Union (Centre) and states.
 
• It divides all the subjects into 3 lists – Union List, State List, and Concurrent List.
 
• The Union List describe the subjects under the control of the central Government, the State List describes the subjects under the jurisdiction of states being the Concurrent List describes the subjects which are under the joint jurisdiction of the Centre of States.
 
• Subjects of Three Lists:
 
 
• The Union List Subjects (**100 **Subjects).
 
• State List (61 Subjects).
 
• Concurrent List (**52** Subjects).
 
 
 
• The subjects which do not fall in these lists that is residuary subjects have been given to the Centre.
 
• ‘**Foreign jurisdiction**’ is item 16 under the Union List.

questions.question: The process of depositing a layer of zinc on iron is called ___________.
questions.solution: Galvanizing is the process of depositing a protective layer of zinc on iron or steel to avoid rusting. The most commonly used method of galvanization is hot dip galvanizing in which iron or steel units are submerged in a molten zinc bath.

questions.solution: The discovery of Antarctica is credited to the second expedition of Captain James Cook. In 1773, Cook and his crew crossed the Antarctic Circle for the first time. Although they could not reach the southern continent, they saw the icebergs and nearby islands.

questions.question: Citizen of which neighbouring country does not require a passport or visa to enter India?
questions.solution: Citizens of Nepal do not need a passport or visa to enter India. They can enter India with driver’s licence or voter’s ID card or ration card as identity proof and can stay and work in India indefinitely. The same is true for Indians going to Nepal.

questions.question: ___________ project is an ambitious Union Government Project which integrates the efforts to clean and protect the Ganga river in a comprehensive manner.
questions.solution: The Namami Ganga Yojana, officially known as the Integrated Ganga Conservation Mission, is an ambitious Union Government scheme to clean and protect the river Ganga. It was approved by the Cabinet in June, 2014 with a budget of Rs 20,000 crore to achieve the twin objective of pollution control and rejuvenation of the national river.

questions.question: The force exerted by a magnet is an example of _________.
questions.solution: Non-contact forces are those which act on a body without physically coming in contact with that body. Examples of non-contact force include gravitational force, magnetic force, electrostatic force and nuclear force. Contrarily, a contact force, like muscular and frictional force, is applied by one body on another when they come in physical contact with each other.

questions.question: The final of 2014 FIFA Men's World Cup was played between which of the following countries?
questions.solution: The 2014 FIFA World Cup was the 20th FIFA World Cup. The final match was played on 13 July, 2014 between Germany and Argentina, in which Germany defeated the latter. The final score was 1-0.

questions.question: _________ influences the rate of weathering and humus in soil formation.
questions.solution: Soil formation is heavily dependent on the climate of a region. The speed of weathering of parent rock, and thereby the mineral composition and concentration of organic matter, is determined by temperature and precipitation. Temperature fluctuations are responsible for faster physical weathering of rocks.

questions.question: The longitudes of main land of India extends between __________.
questions.solution: India is a South Asian country lying entirely in the northern and eastern hemispheres. Its latitudinal extent is 8⁰4’ N to 37⁰6’ N latitudes and longitudinal extent is 68⁰7'53" E to 97⁰24'47" E longitudes.

questions.question: The short run average cost curve is ____ shaped.
questions.solution: A cost curve maps the costs incurred by an enterprise at different levels of output. In the short term, the average cost curve is U-shaped. The reason is that, in the beginning of production, fixed factors of a firm remain the same and the change only takes place in variable factors (like labour, raw material, etc). As the output increases, the cost per unit gets distributed more and more. Thus, the average cost begins to fall and reaches a minimum when the firm is operating at its optimum capacity. Now, if the firm expands its scale of production further with the same fixed resources, the average cost starts rising.

questions.question: An image formed by a plane mirror, that cannot be obtained on a screen is called _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e __**Virtual Image,**__

A virtual image is one which is formed by the apparent divergence of light rays from a point rather than their actual divergence.

Such an image cannot be projected on a screen because the light rays do not actually converge at a point. Images formed by mirrors are always virtual.

A real image can be viewed when a screen is placed in the plane of convergence, alternatively, one may also view the real image directly.

 A** real image is the collection of focus points actually made by converging rays,** while **a virtual image is the collection of focus points made by extensions of diverging rays.**

questions.concept: Chemistry, Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry
questions.question: A change in which a substance undergoes a change in its physical properties is called ___________.
questions.solution:
A **physical change** is one in which a substance undergoes a change in its** physical properties**, like **colour, smell, shape, size**, etc. but its **chemical composition** remains unchanged.

**Physical changes** can be used to separate mixtures into separate compounds but they cannot separate compounds into their constituent elements.

The normal range of red blood cells, per million cubic of blood, for a healthy adult male is 4.9-6.2 and for females is 4.2-5.4.

questions.question: ___________ is the most ecologically relevant environmental factor.

questions.solution:
This sum is the sum of an AP with first term a = 21 and difference d = 1

Let n be the total numbers in the AP

Sum of AP = n/2[first term + last term]

⇒ Sum of AP = n/2[21 + 39]

Average = Sum of AP/total numbers

⇒ Average = [(n/2)(60)]/n

∴ Average = 30

questions.question: A farmer buys a goat and a sheep for Rs. 3500. He sold the sheep at a profit of 20 percent and the goat at a loss of 10 percent. If he sold both the animals at the same price, then the cost price (in Rs) of the cheaper animal was?
questions.solution:
Given: CP of both animals = Rs. 3500 and SP of both the animals are same

Let the CP of goat be Rs g and CP of sheep be Rs. s

⇒ g + s = 3500 ----(i)

⇒ g(1 + 20/100) = s(1 - 10/100)

⇒ 1.2g = 0.9s

⇒ g = 3s/4 ----(ii)

Substituting (ii) in (i)

⇒ 3s/4 + s = 3500

⇒ 7s/4 = 3500

⇒ s = (3500 × 4)/7 = 2000

⇒ g = 3s/4 = 1500

So, g < s

questions.solution:
Let the total number of candidates be a

The number of candidates that were selected = 11a/13

The number of candidates that were not selected = 2a/13

When 40 less candidates apply, the number becomes a - 40

When 20 less candidates are selected, the number of selected candidates becomes (11a/13) - 20

Unselected students in new scenario = (a - 40) - [(11a/13) - 20]

New ratio becomes = (11a/13) - 20/{(a - 40) - [(11a/13) - 20]} = 10

⇒ (11a/13) - 20 = 10{(a - 40) - [(11a/13) - 20]}

⇒ 11a/13 - 20 = 10[2a/13 - 20]

⇒ 11a/13 - 20 = 20a/13 - 200

⇒ 9a/13 = 180

Multiplying above equation by 13/9

∴ a = 260

 ⇒ 0.1 × 100 = r

∴ r = 10

questions.question: Two cars A and B travel from one city to another, at speeds of 35 km/hr and 45 km/hr respectively. If car B takes 2 hours lesser time than car A for the journey, then the distance (in kms) between the two cities is?

⇒ 35t = 45t - 90

⇒ 10t = 90

⇒ t = 9

Putting t = 9 in (i)

⇒ 35 × 9 = a

∴ a = 315

questions.question: The sum of a fraction and 10 times its reciprocal is 37/4. What is the fraction?

questions.solution:
Let the first term of A.P. be a and let the difference be d

⇒ a + d = 8 ----(i)

⇒ a + 5d = 20 ----(ii)

Subtracting (i) from (ii)

⇒ 4d = 20 - 8 = 12

⇒ d = 3

Putting the value of d in (i)

⇒ a + 3 = 8

⇒ a = 8 - 3 = 5

So, 20th term = a + 19d = 5 + 19 × (3) = 5 + 57 = 62

questions.question: What is the equation of a line which has 3 as x-intercept and -5 as y-intercept?

⇒ y = [(y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁)]x - 5

⇒ y = [(-5)/(-3)]x - 5

⇒ y = 5x/3 - 5

Multiplying above equation by 3

⇒ 3y = 5x - 15

⇒ 5x - 3y = 15

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (3, 2) in the line y = -2?
questions.solution:
To find: reflection of the point (3 , 2) in the line y = -2

The equation of line is: y + 2 = 0

The formula for finding the image of a point (x₁,y₁) to the line ax + by + c = 0 is given by:

(x - x₁)/a = (y - y₁)/b = - 2(ax₁ + by₁ + c)/(a² + b²)

Here, a = 0, b = 1 and c = 2

So, we have

(y - 2)/(1) = -2(2 + 2)/(1) and (x - 3) = 0

⇒ y - 2 = -8 and x = 3

⇒ y = -6 and x = 3
